company_info.company_description: "We are a local, independent, SAA (Solar Accreditation) approved solar retailer based in Central Victoria. With over 25 years’ electrical and solar experience we understand exactly how to help people save on their energy bills and contribute to a greener economy.We pride ourselves in making sure every customer is 100% satisfied with our service and their solar system, from initial consultation right through to installation, and beyond. We only use professional local installers and the most trusted solar brands.We specialise in solar systems for residential, commercial businesses and rural farms. All consultations include comprehensive savings calculations, site inspection and roof suitability inspection prior to installation."To check out some of our installationsfollow us on Facebook."
company_info.specializations: solar systems for residential, commercial businesses and rural farms

reviews.review_description: Midland Solar were fantastic to deal with. The quoting process was clear and quick, and the installation was punctual, tidy, and very efficient. The team communicated well throughout the whole process and made everything easy. They handled the grid connection and checked in afterwards to make sure everything was working properly. Great service and highly recommended.

Dealing with Midland Solar was great. Leah came out to assess our property, providing options and educating us on the best savings and how our system would work.The installation crew arrived on time and worked efficiently.We have changed electricity providers and recieved our first bill and couldnt believe the savings already, we couldnt be happier. Our system was sized correctly for our needsFrom sales, to administration, to installation, the entire team was fantastic.Thank you Midland Solar!
Excellent from quoting to installation.  Everyone was very helpful from the onset.

Fantastic company to deal with. Leah was terrific, great source of information, she suggested the battery size to add on to our existing solar setup, and she was spot on. Really great communication from her and from the installer subsequently. Very happy with the outcome! And so pleased they are local as well.

Midland Solar were wonderful for my battery installation. High integrity, great communication, punctual and friendly. Can’t speak highly enough - I love my new SigEn battery and am enjoying being in control of my energy costs! So liberating…

Leah & Andy were incredibly helpful every step of the way and were very upfront and honest throughout the the entire process. I am very happy with my ALPHAESS system, there was a minor issue with the way the safety bollard was placed and when I told Midland Solar they very quickly rectified the issue and it passed the ESV inspection with no issues. I recommend Midland Solar highly and it was a pleasure doing business with them.

The quote from Midland was clear and was slightly lower than the others. Once I had decided on Midland to install my solar panels they were very responsive and listened to all my queries and accepted all my particular requests regarding the installation. The installation itself was done very promptly and the team of installer did the job very efficiently. We are very happy with the completed job and the costs was very  reasonable.

We chose to use Midland Solar again after having them install our solar a few years ago, although we did get quotes from other companies, none matched up to the service we previously experienced with Midland Solar.  Once again they didn’t disappoint.I have to heap praise on Leah who was incredibly patient and helpful, answering my many questions happily, and if she didn't know an answer straight away she took the time to research and get back to me quickly.  Andy was also great to deal with, keeping us informed of progress, ensuring we understood the rebate process and responding to our calls quickly.This time we installed a Haier heat pump and a new electric oven to replace a gas one, and the team also capped the gas at the meter as part of the job. The installers were excellent—professional, accommodating of my requests, tidied up afterwards, and it was clear they were skilled tradespeople.  They also took the time to explain the new hot water system to me.We've found the new hot water system really good —the water is hotter than our old system, so we’ve had to use a bit more cold water to balance it, the pressure is strong and consistent.Overall, we’re very happy with the experience and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Midland Solar. They even offered us a Marong special discount, which we really appreciated.
Great customer service. Battery supply is the current issue due to high demand.

We selected Midland Solar as we had dealt with them before and were impressed with the process. Leah helped us assess our usage and we added extra solar panels and a 13.5kwh battery. Andy completed a site inspection and the System was installed in July 25. On sunny days we are not using electricty from the grid during the day and still have enough charge the battery to cover the peak times which is great for winter. On days that we are away from home we are fully charging our battery from solar, and not drawing from the grid at all. We are confident to recommend Midland Solar to others without hesitation.

Midland Solar are amazing to deal with. We have renewed our panels as well as bought a solar battery. They have been fantastic in every aspect of our purchases. They are very knowledgeable and nothing is too much trouble for them. Leah and Andy are wonderful in every aspect of sales and service. I highly recommend them is you are looking at getting solar.
All aspects of the installation of my solar panels were managed professionally and efficiently.  I could not have asked for better service

A fantastic  installation which was more involved due to placing it away from the house. The installer was friendly and answered all our questions. Efficient and tidied up afterwards......very impressed. The sales and quoting was very helpful.

Sales process was efficient and informativeInstallation was timely and undertaken really neatly. They took the time to ensure that there were no ugly conduits that were surface mounted and instead ran the power through my walls, despite this being a more expensive solution that required more complex insulation.Great company to deal with.
Thanks Andy and group for the friendly, professional service. Well done keep up the great work.

The quoting process was great with Leah being very knowledgeable and more than happy to answer all my questions.Installation was smooth. Mick and Nick were punctual, efficient, friendly and very tidy. The panels look great and it seems to be a very professional job.There was a problem with the inverter, it seemed to be doing it’s job properly but kept sending error messages. Andy arranged for the inverter to be changed over with minimal fuss and no extra cost to me.Highly recommend the whole team at Midland Solar.
Staff very friendly and knowledgable. Installation was quick and no fuss.   All paperwork has been done and everything was easy and no question was too bothersome.

Dealing with Midland Solar was easy, they did our solar a few years back and when I called regarding a battery Leah advised the return on investment would be low and advised that a heat pump would be more beneficial. Midland Solar don't just try to hard sell you a device, they provide sound quality advice based on your needs. I was happy they didn't just try and sell me something I wouldn't benefit from and did a full analysis. Andy came out to assess for a heat pump and Leah provided quotes and options.The installation crew arrived on time, worked efficiently and no mess left.With the upgrade from our old gas hot water unit to the new heat pump, we now have a strong full flow of hot water to our showers.For honest and reliable information we can recommend calling Leah and Andy at Midland Solar.
The whole process from start to finish was exceptional. I would recommend Midland Solar to anyone wishing a competitive hassle free Solar installation!

Leah at Midland Solar was very helpful and recommended a good system at a good price. Installation of the heat pump hot water system was well organized, on time, and done to a high standard. The whole process including rebate application was very smooth.

100% the only place you should be going to for solar and solar install. Midland Solar are the absolute best by far. Steve and Andy are so passionate about what they do and the product they supply. They will guide you through the whole process and recommend the best set up for you and what you hope to achieve. They do not rush you at any stage and spend as much time as need to make you comfortable with your purchases. Big shout out to the instal team as well Nick, Mick and the other one (private joke) were equally amazing. They are not the cheapest but they are not the dearest either, worth every penny you pay. Thanks again Midland Big Thumbs Up

We were very impressed with the Midland, they actually came out and looked at the property and the roof. They answered any questions and their explanations were very easy to understand.The installation went very smoothly with polite and punctual tradies.We are just waiting for the final inspection but extremely happy with Midland Solar.
All done in good spirit, professionally and on schedule. The installation team worked a long day (~7.30am to 6.30pm) to get it all done in the day. Very happy. Would recomend Midland to others.

The process of getting the quote and understanding it was handled very professionally by Steve at Midland Solar. He was patient and very knowledgeable of the solar world, their products and what they would deliver. The site visit was excellent, Andy from Midland Solar was very knowledgeable and nothing seemed to be a problem. The install was seamless, the electricians were respectful and great tradesmen. I can't recommend Midland Solar highly enough.It was refreshing to deal with a company that was honest and forthright, they didn't try and "snow me" at all and I felt very comfortable in dealing with them. All in all a very positive experience and I have been referring them to people who are looking at solar installations.I reckon I toyed with getting solar for about 5 years, but every other company to my mind were shonky. Midland Solar were recommended to me by a neighbour and the whole process from start to finish was a dream.

From our first meeting with the team at Midland Solar to the completion of the project we have been very pleased with their advice and service. We had thoughts about a big system and after discussion with the team took their advice and have had a smaller system installed. The advice included the benefits to us with the smaller system which would suit our needs and also saving on the costs for the solar system. For this we are grateful and recommend to any who are considering the installation of solar to talk with the team at Midland Solar on a system to suit their needs.

Right from the start of the process the guys at midland were approachable and couldn’t do enough to help us out. Explained everything right through the process and kept us updated on the system install. We had an issue with wifi connection and even though we are 150km from their base they drove out to us and fixed the issue immediately. They ensured the grid connection went smoothly and we are very happy with the finished result. So far the package has performed better than we expected even with limited sunlight due to winter timing.

Steve and the team at Midland Solar were absolutely fantastic from the start. They reviewed my consumption and came up with the perfect system to suit my large families needs.You can’t go wrong using Midland Solar.

Wonderful all round service from quote process to installation and connection. We had lots of questions and Steve was very helpful with explaining answers and providing solutions. Installation team were also great -  they were on time and friendly. Excited using our new solar system.

We can’t thank Midland Solar and the team enough for our installation . Right down to the young polite staff on our roof to the expert advice from Andy and Steve . Our power bill has been slashed by over  50%. The whole experience from our quote to the final checks  after installation was amazing the Midland team were  informative all the way thru the process . We loved using a local business that we could trust and rely on and no question no matter how silly it sounded was always answered . Being a local business the response to your query was always answered instantly . Thank you Midland Solar

Sales and quoting were straightforward, and I did not feel pressured to commit. Andy was the only person who went up on the roof and measured.Installation went smoothly and as promised. The installers were punctual and polite and did an exemplary job.Steve and Andy have been very helpful throughout the process by providing all the necessary information and communication.My experience with Midland Solar has been excellent. I recommend them to anyone considering a solar installation. The team is knowledgeable and professional and provides first-rate customer service.

I recently had a solar installation completed by Midland Solar, and I am thoroughly impressed with their service from start to finish.Sales/Quoting Process:Steve was fantastic throughout the sales and quoting process. He was very honest and insightful, taking the time to explain all the different system setups and recommending the best size system for my needs. Given that I have a pool with heating, my energy consumption is quite high. Steve ensured that the system he recommended was suitable and somewhat future-proofed, which I greatly appreciated.Installation:The installation team was exemplary. They were really punctual, tidy, and polite. Their professionalism and attention to detail made the installation process seamless and stress-free.Customer Service:Andy has been extremely helpful throughout the entire engagement. He provided all the necessary information and assisted with organising the grid connection after the installation. Additionally, he took the time to show me how to use the system and ensured that I was comfortable with its operation.Overall, my experience with Midland Solar has been exceptional. I highly recommend them for anyone considering a solar installation. Their team is knowledgeable, professional, and dedicated to providing top-notch customer service.

Andy provided the highest level of customer service from the first time we spoke through to sending manuals and certificates after installation. I was guided through the options and, having a technical background, was provided quick responses to the many questions asked. On the day, the installation was extremely professional. Very happy with the service from Midland Solar and the system installed. Would recommend Midland Solar to anyone looking to replace or add solar to their home.

Steve, Andy and the team were terrific to deal with. After being lead up the garden path by other providers Midland Solar were honest right from the get go. I cannot recommend these guys enough for their professional approach and service.
Excellent knowledge of product & fantastic customer service. Would highly recommend Midland Solar!
Good communication. Easy quoting process. Easy to deal with.Very neat installation. Ready to assist after install.

I cannot recommend Midland Solar enough, reliable and very easy to deal with.The panels were expertly installed and the whole process went very smoothly.You will always get an honest conversation about what is good for your situation, not what is the best for the installer.
Happy with the process. Appreciated the way Midland Solar explained the panels and Inverter and then the process for installation.

From the quote, initial contact, saving me money, the install and the after support I cannot rate this company higher. If they gave me 10 stars to rate it wouldn’t be enough.It’s been the most easy, hassle free and stress free purchase I’ve ever made in Australia.Cannot rate them enoughThanks team midland solar
Friendly people and had no problems with the installation. Would definitely recommend to others.

Steve and Andy were very helpful during the quoting phase. Good customer service once the quote was accepted and deposit paid . Installer was punctual,polite and efficient. All rubbish cleaned up and removed. The system is working fine, just waiting for configuration from our energy supplier. Highly recommended.

Midland Solar visited our home to make a quote at the time that they said they would, then they spent considerable time at their office a few days later explaining which system was best for our needs. Their quote was reasonable, they helped us with the rebate application then when it was approved, arranged to have our solar panels installed by a very friendly and efficient team who also showed us how to access the app. Midland are in the process of organising our grid connection but Christmas will delay it. All in all a very friendly, efficient service. Thank you for your help with the arranging of our quotes. We opted not to get the loan but we could have paid a cheaper price with the loan.

The team at Midland Solar were incredibly knowledgeable and easy to deal with.Called them up one day, site inspection that very afternoon and a quote before the end of the day.Installation was quick, roughly 5 hours, and installer answered all of my questions.Also generally cheaper than other businesses and didn't try to screw me around with too big of a system!Very much recommend Midland Solar!

The whole thing went swimmingly, the quoter even downsized me because I went overboard.Install was seamless, polite, quick and tidy. All done in a day and signed off by the government mob same day - brilliant customer service.

Andy & Steve at Midland Solar tell it like it is.They provided me with the information and insights necessary to make an informed decision on what was best in our situation. There was no hard selling or up selling, just practical advice and patience with my barrage of questions.

From start to finish I've been incredibly impressed with the service, honesty and response from Midland Solar. From the sales staff to the installation and connection it's been brilliant. Highly recommend Midland Solar. Fantastic.

Andy and Steve at Midland Solar provide an honest, helpful and stress-free experience without hassles. Nothing was a problem and the initial enquiry, advice, proposal and installation went smoothly and efficiently. I would highly recommend Midland Solar.

Great to deal with. Steve and Andy provided advice that was clear and with our interests and the best overall outcome the main priority.Highly recommend the Midland Solar team. Steve , Andy, Nick and others at Midland Solar Well Done.

Easy to deal with and happy to give honest feedback on our solar install. Didn't push to get the largest system that could fit on the roof but made sure that the system actually fitted our usage.The installer was quick and efficient, completed in one morning and was fully operational the same day.

Sales was on point, very precise with all information provided and answered all questions without hesitationThe installation was conducted in a timely manner and on time. Can't complain it was installed a lot quicker than I ever expected.The installers where on-site on time, the job only took about 6hrs to install a 6.6Kw/h system and they cleaned and took away any rubbish/mess they made on the day.The Midland Team  did a Top Job 5 stars.

Steve & Andy at Midland Solar we’re so helpful and provided clear information about the solar process. They communicated each step clearly which was reassuring. I’m so happy I went with a local company close to where I live.

The initial contact from Midland Solar was impressive, no pressure, quality information with a total breakdown on what Solar would do for me. Buying a Solar system can be a confusing experience, Midland took the confusion out of the experience and made you feel confident of your decision.The Midland installation team were like an extension of the initial purchase experience. First of all they were over a week early than initially planned (great) . They were professional, explained how the installation would proceed and finished the job on the day. Before leaving Mick explained how the inverter worked and what to expect from our electricity supplier.It’s reassuring to deal with a company that’s so far ahead of it’s competition in all aspects of the purchase. I cannot speak highly of both Steven and Andy in the way they handled all aspects of the deal from initial purchase to the grid connection.I would recommend Midland to members of my family, I have recommended them to two of my friendsA very happy customer

Midland supported me through a change in my original plans for solar & battery to the eventual installation of a larger solar-only system with generator transfer switch as more suitable for my needs.Service was good throughout the process.  They were unfalteringly polite, and conscientious in returning my calls when I didn't get through immediately.  There have been a couple of complications - not caused by Midland - in the process of completing the installation and they have helped and supported me through these.They pro-actively submitted a High Voltage complaint to Powercor when this proved necessary, and helped in organising the grid connection following the installation.Altogether I highly recommend Midland Solar for solar installations in the Bendigo region.

The pre sales service was great.The company helped me with the rebate application plus getting me on the grid, kept me updated on when installation would be.Overall very helpful.Mick and Nick my installers were polite, professional, tidy and efficient.The inspector was prompt, polite and helpful.Overall experience was great

Three companies supplied quotes. One terrible. One mediocre. One exceptional.Salesperson did not come across as just “sales”. Knowledgeable, respectful and professional. Great advice with all queries responded to promptly.Installation was as prompt as weather permitted. Two fabulous, polite and professional young men who discussed the process and panel layout throughout the installation.I did express concern that when the government Is pushing for renewable energy and solar installation, feed into the grid is not automatic. I complained to the Environmental and Planning minister regarding this and Powercor reversed their position on this, so I will have full feed into the grid.I was expecting at least a three week delay for final inspection and I felt for the lonely inspector because qualified certifies were reduced over covid and have not been returned to pre-covid levels, let alone increased with increased demand. But…he is coming tomorrow!I cannot recommend Midland Solar more highly. Very happy customer.
Fantastic people, can highly recommend. They communicated well across the entire process, and went above and beyond to ensure the installation and inspection were completed in a prompt manner.

This was a no-fuss installation from start to finish -- from sales to installation.No hesitation in recommending Midland.Good people, sound advice and a professional attitude throughout the process.Just waiting on the final inspection and we should be good to go.
Fantastic professional service started at initial phone call, through to quoting then install.The whole process was much quicker than I had anticipated.Highly recommend Midland Solar.

From first contact to the final payment, Andy and his team at Midland solar were courteous, professional and understanding of our needs. We would have no issues in recommending Midland solar based on our practical dealings with such a high rated and professional business. All areas of our needs were met, the best one stop business we have had the pleasure to deal with, hassle free service.  Thank you all at Midland Solar Bendigo.
Very happy with the productsDid a very good and tidy installationconnection is in progress
Excellent customer service. system fully installed, up and running in only one day.Great system and quality installation.Would recomend to anyone
Very easy to deal with installation crew had system done 4 hours very happy overall

The whole process from initial enquiry to ‘go live’ was smooth and effortless. I had held off for years due to being a bit overwhelmed by the market and options but Midland Solar were honest, clear and straightforward to work with.
So far all excellent service. Awaiting installation after our roof is repainted in the early new year.

Midland Solar were fantastic to deal with from the initial quote to being available for questions after the recent installation. They gave me the best price and the installation team were super efficient and friendly - took about half a day. I could not fault them. Just waiting for my electricity retailer to come to the party now.

Sales person was very helpful & explained things I was unsure about.The Installation only took a few hours, they were ontime, started around 7:30-8am, and were done by 1-2pm.They were friendly & answered a couple of questions I had.Midland Solar organized everything, except the SolarVic application (which by law, I had to do myself), but they helped with any questions I had regarding the application

Andy & the whole team at midland solar have been professional, knowledgeable, informative & more then helpful anytime of the day or night every step during our entire solar system process.From the installation & workmanship completed to the up to date communications was nothing but exceptional and could not be happier...!If you are ready or looking to install a solar system for your home there is really only one place to go & that's Midland Solar..!!!Many Thanks Midland Solar & The Team.. :)
Cannot rate the customer service level highly enough.  From the plan of panels, through to specifications and very professional installation.  They follow up and see the process through.
I had a great experience with Midland Solar. They were very helpful and went the extra mile to make sure we got a good result. Can recommend without hesitation.
Great guys, highly recommend. Very helpful during the sales process and started the installation the next week!

Midland Solar really delivered. They were responsive, always punctual, and they walked us throughtvthe process, not just the system, but also the business of obtaining the solar rebates.The tradesmen were polite, and the quality of the installation worknis top notch.Highly recommend Midland Solar.

From having Steve visit to quote in 24 hours from the request, explaining options, getting the quote through installation, QA check and connection into the grid everything was done with the minimum fuss and full explanation.Everything was arranged by Midland Solar, the installers were excellent, the safety check went well and connection to the grid was all arranged.I have no issues at all in recommending Midland Solar to anyone wanting Solar.We are on a small rural property and that wasn't an issue either.

From getting in touch, to first contact this was an excellent experience. Andy and his team responded quickly, were out to the house within a week and talked me through my options. Judging light and options, I was comfortable early with the approach.Once the deposit was sorted, they were in touch quickly and the great service continued with the install team. Friendly and professional, Mick and the guys sorted out the install in less than a day. The job itself is clean, neat and feels extremely high quality. The inspector (independent authority) was out within a week and quickly gave it all a thumbs up. We then had a call from our elec retailer 24h later and BOOM - solar power.Really impressed all. Thanks for the great work.

Steve was sensational in the way he explained the sales & quoting process. Very professional.The installation process was perfect, very tidy & quick even though they had a delay with weather conditions.Customer service was fantastic told me everything that was to be done & keep me up to date with & when everything happening along the way.Great work Steve & Andy

Sales/quoting process.After submitting my quote request I received two phone calls from suppliers that day and one call a few days later.   The first took great care to make sure they fully understood my solar needs (size of system needed etc.) and that I understood how everything would work from applying for the rebate, to the installation through to grid connection etc.      They also drew my attention to the history of Solar Quotes which is also on your website but I hadn't looked at that bit!   It was really interesting.    I chose to go with that company as neither of the other two companies measured up to that first call.InstallationThe installation was quick, efficient, and the installers friendly and informative.   They tidied up after themselves and carefully put waste in the correct rubbish bins.    They even arrived early!Customer ServiceThe only problem I had was submitting the online forms for the government rebate.    It kept refusing to accept my phone number.    I tried different search engines and finally rang the help number.    Staff there (more than one phone call) were extremely pleasant and tried hard to help and said that if all else failed they would send a hard copy for me to submit.    I rang Midland Sola and they offered to drop in and do it via their mobile phone.   I tried my phone but it still wouldn't work.     I was going away and had other things that took up my time so in all it was 2 weeks later that I rang the rebate people back and they took me through the application (again!).    After some more head scratching we finally got the application submitted.     After that everything happened quickly - particularly the 'inspection' which I was told would take some weeks but in fact happened within days.

The team at Midland solar made getting solar easy. From start to finish. From there punctual helpful service and advice to the high quality installation. Would highly recommend the team at Midland solar
Absolutely brilliant. All the way from getting a quote to installation, great communication & customer service.

The whole process of organising a quote, accepting the quote and the installation of the solar panels was easy and efficient from start to finish. Nothing was too much of a trouble and the communication excellent.

Midland Solar were very easy to deal with, and extremely honest upfront around costs and benefits.  We installed Micro-inverters, which although more expensive, suited our location better.  The results have spoken for themselves.All time frames promised were met, and the final installation of the black panels on a dark roof look fantastic, including painting the end of the rails where they were cut so they were all black and matching.Midland Solar also made the connection to the grid seamless.The follow up service around finding us the best deal on our electricity provider was spot on.  Took all of the hassle out finding the cheapest provider.I am more than happy to recommend Andy and the team...

The knowledge and skills were second to none.  Factual information and ease of product understanding and explanation to us ensured we got the  perfect product to meet our needs.  We were kept informed  and updated in respect to installation and after market follow up.  A very friendly and professional team.  Very happy with our system and have recommended them to others interested in purchasing a solar system.

Very professional team from quote to installation, the solar installation is very neat an well presented, all questions were answered in a prompt an professional manner. We will be highly recommending too others.
Midland Solar was a fantastic company to deal with from start to finish. Polite, on time and informative on every step of the way. Highly recommended.

The sale process was made easy with full explanation and assessment of my needsThe installation was seamless Punctual and efficientCustomer service was excellent with help for the rebate scheme. Service with a smile.
The process was smooth, was kept informed at every step. Great company to deal with.

The sales team were so friendly and explained everything.  It made it so much easier to understand as a lot of it was over my head.The Installation guys left no mess, explained what would happen next and even played with our dog.From start to finish everything was explained and they did it all.  I didn't have to do a thing.  They even sent the information to Powercor and our retailer.
Took the time to talk me through the process, provide practical advise. No bullshit.

Having dealt with another company and getting nowhere for 5 months, Midland Solar provided an immediate and satisfactory quote, chased up Powercor for  approval for an export capacity of 5.0 kVA, something we did not think we would get! Within 2 weeks of the quote we were up and running with solar. During the whole process we were kept informed and the actual installation went like a dream.

I found Midlands Solar to be really helpful to deal with they gave me sound advice right from the start. I was kept fully informed through out the process, installation was quick, clean and to a high standard.I can't say much more other than the fact that I could not recommend them more highly, particularly as they are a locally owned busienss.

We highly recommend Andy and the team at Midland Solar! Andy was able to explain the process and associated solar jargon in plain English for us to understand. Once we had decided on our system, we were continually updated with the progress of our order. The installation was completed so quickly, and we were receiving feed-in credits in no time.Even after the job was completed, Andy compared retailers for us, to ensure we were getting the best deal with our new solar. Thank you Midland Solar!

Midland Solar were recommended to me by a friend who, like me, had a fantastic experience with them.From my initial enquiry to post installation follow up, the team have been incredibly efficient and responsive.Always available to answer queries throughout the process and were happy to pop in and see me in person to take me using the app on my phone for the inverter.They made the solar grants process so easy, it was a non event. They were prompt and turned up when they said they were going to.The team that did the install were fantastic, I couldn’t fault them either. They were all personable and friendly and the quality of the install is perfect, everything is symmetrical, square, well placed and neat.Not rushed or done with out care. I’ve now recommended Midland solar to my own family and friends. I really couldn’t speak more highly about.

We had looked at getting solar previously and our experience during the quote process had left us less than impressed. A friend recommended Midland Solar, so we gave them a call.From the moment we started communicating we were struck by how professional and thorough the team at Midland Solar were. They took time to understand our energy usage and habits and there was no attempt to sell us a large system just for the sake to it. The process of quote to install was handled so well, every step was explained and easy to follow. The team that undertook the install were incredibly efficient and did excellent work - we needed 2 inverters due to being on 2-phase and the installation is incredibly neat, it looks fantastic.When we installed Powercor advised we were not able to feed back in to the grid, so it was a great surprise to get a call from Andy, over a month after our system had been put in, letting us know that Powercor had increased their feed-in limit in our area and that Midland would be coming to get our system set up to feed in!We cannot recommend the Midland Solar team more highly. From start to finish and even beyond, they provide such fantastic service.
Brilliant service offered and received. They fully explained the system, rebates and cost. Courteous and prompt.
Andy was very approachable & honest with his opinions.  Everything was done in a timely manner & professionally installed.  Customer service including post installation follow up has been great.

I was recommended Midland Solar by a good friend and have no regrets what so ever. From the initial quoting process, no question was to stupid, and all the help with the forms that had to filled out. Nothing was a problem. The installation guys turned up at the time I was told. They were polite, well mannered and even had a joke or two. When the installation was done they totally tidied up and you wouldn't have known they had been there. Very impressed.I have no hesitation in recommending Midland Solar to anybody who is thinking of getting solar panels.
